tool_args.rationale: The normalized response y/u_now is positive in all short-horizon pilots and falls to about -0.467 at H=20. This reversal supports a fast positive component opposed by a slower negative component. Fit both amplitudes and both timescales to all six paid observations and test the resulting forecast on fresh data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A fixed-sign Arrhenius response cannot fit positive pilot responses and a negative H=20 response when u_now is positive throughout.
The acquired H=20 observation already distinguishes the two proposed mechanisms by sign.
The five distinct pilot horizons constrain early curvature, and the long-horizon point anchors the response at the forecast target. Fresh confirmation is the next test.
